report.executiveSummary: During the incident window, Contoso Retail customers experienced degraded checkout and product catalogue performance (p99: 1250ms). Investigation evidence indicates the root cause is most likely associated with the active failure domain, specifically: Client-side p99 latency: 1250ms vs server-side Cosmos latency: 18ms — 1232ms gap indicates client/SDK or host overhead; Cosmos DB 429 RateLimitExceeded: 9 in last 5 min on products container; Unindexed query on ProductsNoIndex: full scan, high RU expected. Azure Cosmos DB service-side health remained nominal (server-side latency: 18ms). Azure SQL Database remained healthy. Immediate corrective actions are identified and safe to execute without service escalation.
report.engineeringRca: Telemetry shows p99 latency at 1250ms with 9 Cosmos 429 events, 880 RU/min consumption, host CPU 26%, and SQL latency 50ms. The active toggles (missingIndexing) directly align with the observed failure signature. The client-to-server latency delta of 1232ms indicates most latency is introduced in the application, SDK, query design, or host execution path rather than inside the Azure Cosmos DB service plane.
